🔥 OTT की दुनिया में एक और बड़ा धमाका होने जा रहा है!

Sony LIV ने अपनी बहुचर्चित फ़्रैंचाइज़ी की अगली सीरीज़ Scam 2010 का पहला लुक आधिकारिक तौर पर जारी कर दिया है।

इस नई सीरीज़ का निर्देशन Hansal Mehta कर रहे हैं, जबकि इसका निर्माण Birla Studios और Applause Entertainment मिलकर कर रहे हैं।

सीरीज़ में Siddharth Bodke मुख्य भूमिका निभाते हुए नज़र आएंगे और यह जनवरी 2027 में Sony LIV पर प्रीमियर की जाएगी।

यह नया शो साल 2020 में आई सुपरहिट सीरीज़ Scam 1992: The Harshad Mehta Story की अपार सफलता के बाद आ रहा है।

अभिनेता Siddharth Bodke ने इस रोल पर बात करते हुए कहा कि यह उनके करियर का सबसे चुनौतीपूर्ण अनुभव रहा और Hansal Mehta के साथ काम करना सीखने से भरा रहा।

🎬 क्या आप Hansal Mehta की Scam 2010 देखने के लिए उत्साहित हैं? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में ज़रूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.text:
Sony LIV has unveiled the first look of Scam 2010, the next instalment in the Scam franchise. Directed by Hansal Mehta and produced by Birla Studios and Applause Entertainment, the upcoming series will feature Siddharth Bodke in the lead role. It is scheduled to premiere on Sony LIV in January 2027.
The new series follows the success of Scam 1992: The Harshad Mehta Story, which was also directed by Hansal Mehta. The 2020 series received considerable audience appreciation and established the Scam franchise as a prominent title in India's streaming space.
Speaking about his experience of working on the series, Siddharth Bodke said that understanding the person behind the character was an important part of his preparation. He also described the role as one of the most challenging experiences of his career.
“Playing lead character in Scam 2010 has honestly been one of the most challenging and special experiences of my career. What interested me the most was understanding the man behind the image. We all know the larger-than-life personality, but I wanted to explore who he really was, what drove him, and why he made the choices he did,” the actor said.
Siddharth further spoke about spending considerable time with the character and working with director Hansal Mehta. “I’ve lived with this character for a long time, and the process has taught me so much, not just as an actor but also as a person. Working with Hansal sir has been an incredible learning experience and a lot of fun! The Scam series already has such a strong legacy, and being trusted to take that forward is a huge responsibility. I’m genuinely excited for people to finally see what we’ve created,” he added.
With Scam 2010, Hansal Mehta returns to the franchise following Scam 1992. The upcoming series is set to premiere exclusively on Sony LIV in January 2027.
